title: You're overpaying for Claude every single day and don't even know it
description:
You're overpaying for Claude every day and you don't even know it. Every prompt burns tokens. Every usage limit is a paywall. Most people just accept it as the cost of using the best coding AI on the planet.

Four free community plugins quietly fix all of it.

OmniRoute reroutes you across 300+ providers the second you hit a wall, and unlocks around 1.6 billion free tokens a month. Headroom compresses your context so Claude stops re-reading what it already knows. ClaudeMem gives it real memory across sessions. Task Observer runs in the background, learns how you work, and upgrades your setup on its own.

Install all four and the token cost on a normal task drops from about 11,000 to 1,500. Claude stops feeling expensive and starts feeling like the setup you were supposed to have from day one.

Comment TOKENS and I'll send you the guide.

#claudecode #claudeai #aitools #tokens #aicoding #buildwithai #aiagents #developertools #savemoney #opensource
